 Product Description
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Some pieces just work with everything. The Signature Silver Rope Chain is one of them — a slim, tightly twisted rope link with a bright silver-tone finish that adds a bold yet effortless edge to any outfit.

The signature spiral of the rope design catches the light from every angle, giving the chain real depth and a premium feel without ever feeling heavy on the neck. A smooth lobster clasp keeps it secure all day and makes it quick to put on and take off.

• 
Twisted rope design — tightly wound links for a rich, textured shine

• 
Bright silver-tone finish — clean, metallic and easy to style

• 
Secure lobster clasp — comfortable, fuss-free wear

• 
Wear it your way — sleek on its own or paired with a pendant

• 
Everyday-ready — lightweight and made for daily styling

Minimal, versatile and unisex in spirit — a staple chain that earns its place in your everyday rotation.
